requestId.description: Request identifier associated with the order submission.

symbol.description: Trading pair, formatted as BASE-QUOTE (e.g. BTC-USDT).

quote.description: Quote currency of the trading pair.

orderState.description: Current order status label (e.g. active, inactive, cancelled).

orderType.description: Numeric order-type code (limit, market, peg, TWAP).

orderPrice.description: Order limit price. Zero for market orders.

orderValue.description: Current order value expressed in the user's account currency.

timestamp.description: Order creation timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds.

timeInForce.description: Time-in-force policy: GTC, IOC, FOK, or null if not applicable.

orderCurrency.description: Indicates which size fields are populated: "quote" (quote-denominated) or "base" (base-denominated).

originalOrderBaseSize.description: Original order size in base currency. Populated only when orderCurrency is "base".

originalOrderQuoteSize.description: Original order size in quote currency. Populated only when orderCurrency is "quote".

currentOrderBaseSize.description: Current outstanding order size in base currency. Populated only when orderCurrency is "base".

currentOrderQuoteSize.description: Current outstanding order size in quote currency. Populated only when orderCurrency is "quote".

remainingOrderBaseSize.description: Remaining unfilled size in base currency. Populated only when orderCurrency is "base".

remainingOrderQuoteSize.description: Remaining unfilled size in quote currency. Populated only when orderCurrency is "quote".

totalFilledBaseSize.description: Cumulative filled quantity in base currency.

avgFilledPrice.description: Volume-weighted average fill price across all executions of this order.

orderDetailType.description: Order detail category classifying the order's purpose or subtype.

orderDetail.description: Additional order detail metadata associated with orderDetailType.

triggerOrder.description: True if this is a trigger (conditional) order.

triggered.description: True once the trigger condition has fired and the underlying order has been released.

triggerUseLastPrice.description: True if the trigger evaluates against the last-traded price; false if it evaluates against the mark price. Only meaningful for trigger orders.

triggerPrice.description: Effective trigger price. Only meaningful for trigger orders.

triggerOriginalPrice.description: Trigger price originally submitted by the client. Only meaningful for trigger orders.

triggerOrderType.description: Numeric trigger order-type code (stop-loss, take-profit, stop-loss-limit, or take-profit-limit). Only meaningful for trigger orders.

triggerStopPrice.description: Stop price for the trigger order. Only meaningful for trigger orders.

triggerTrailingStopDeviation.description: Trailing stop deviation from the reference price. Only meaningful for trailing-stop trigger orders.

trailValue.description: Trailing offset magnitude. Only meaningful for trailing-stop orders.

trailValueType.description: Interpretation of trailValue (e.g. absolute amount or percentage). Only meaningful for trailing-stop orders.

pegPriceMin.description: Lower cap of the peg price band. Only meaningful for peg orders.

pegPriceMax.description: Upper cap of the peg price band. Only meaningful for peg orders.

pegPriceDeviation.description: Offset applied to the reference price when pegging. Only meaningful for peg orders.

currentPegPrice.description: Current effective peg price. Only meaningful for peg orders.

wrapperOrder.description: True if the order is a wrapper for a group of related orders (e.g. bracket/OCO).

activationPrice.description: Activation price at which the order becomes eligible for execution. Only present for orders that use an activation-price feature.

activationPriceType.description: Reference price type used when evaluating activationPrice. Only present for orders that use an activation-price feature.
